parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The tool result enumerating concrete environment or artifact facts.

exclusion_conditions: The observation returns an application response payload from a service endpoint.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The invocation that issues requests against the live service.

exclusion_conditions: The action only inspects service source code or configuration statically.
The action re-runs build or download steps instead of exercising the service.
The intended request is never issued because the client tool is unavailable.

new.name: CONFIRMS_EXTERNAL_REACHABILITY

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The invocation that contacts the service through a non-loopback host address.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The result of that request, indicating success or failure.
